text:
Hannah Li: noticed oscillating queue lengths on the continuous-batcher when load shifts between tenants A and B. queues fill -> aggressive eviction -> refill in 100-200ms cycle. this looks like positive feedback.
Diego Ruiz: yep, saw same in staging. suspected culprit: our backpressure signal only uses instant queue depth and then we do immediate eviction. that creates hysteresis.
Kavitha Iyer: tradeoffs: immediate eviction keeps latency SLOs but thrashes packing. smoothing the signal reduces churn but increases steady-state latency.
Hannah Li: idea: introduce damped signals + cooldown windows. e.g. compute smoothed_depth = alpha * depth + (1-alpha)*smoothed_depth_prev and only evict if smoothed_depth > high_watermark for cooldown_ms.
Diego Ruiz: alpha tuning matters. low alpha = slow reaction; high alpha = noisy. maybe auto-tune alpha based on observed variance.
Kavitha Iyer: auto-tuning needs stability. simpler: two-threshold circuit: enter-evict when depth>H, exit-evict when depth<L (L<H). gives hysteresis. plus a min-evict-interval to avoid repeated flips.
Hannah Li: agree on two-threshold. we should also consider request-affinity: don't evict requests that are within k tokens of completion (heuristic based on generation length). saves waste.
Diego Ruiz: sounds good. but we need admission-level fairness: heavy tenants shouldn't starve small ones. propose token-credit buckets per-tenant with soft-guarantees. credits accrue at steady rate; admission consumes credits proportional to expected token use.
Kavitha Iyer: credit system increases state. we can keep coarse per-tenant-bucket (tier-based) again to limit cardinality. also allow borrowing with repay penalties (lower priority for a period).
Hannah Li: operational metrics: queue_oscillation_rate, evict_cycle_count, average_pack_loss (tokens lost due to eviction), per-tenant starvation_time. add worker_id label.
Diego Ruiz: implement experiment: 1) two-threshold with H=80%, L=40% on queue depth; 2) min-evict-interval=250ms; 3) completion-protection-k=16 tokens. roll to 10% workers for 4h.
Kavitha Iyer: for fairness experiment, do tiered credits: free=1x, pro=2x, enterprise=4x. measure p50/p95 per tier.
Hannah Li: note: rollout abort if pack_efficiency drops >3% or p99 latency increases >20ms.
infra-bot: experiment rollout initiated by Hannah L. config: batcher.eviction.hysteresis=true, eviction.H=0.8, eviction.L=0.4, eviction.min_interval_ms=250.
Diego Ruiz: I'll add tracing spans for "evict-decision" and annotate cause (hysteresis|forced). Kavitha, can you add metrics for pack_loss?
Kavitha Iyer: on it. will emit pack_loss.tokens and pack_loss.requests.
Hannah Li: thanks all. keep notes concise here. we'll reconvene after 4h with snapshots. :eyes:
